sql: SELECT pc.ProductCategoryName AS ProductCategoryName, sum(fs.SalesAmount) AS ActualSalesRevenue, any(bud.BudgetAmount) AS BudgetAmount, sum(fs.SalesAmount) - any(bud.BudgetAmount) AS Variance FROM retail.FactSales AS fs INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p ON fs.ProductKey = p.ProductKey INNER JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory AS ps ON p.ProductSubcategoryKey = ps.ProductSubcategoryKey INNER JOIN retail.DimProductCategory AS pc ON ps.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey LEFT JOIN (SELECT sp.ProductCategoryKey AS ProductCategoryKey, sum(sp.Amount) AS BudgetAmount FROM retail.FactStrategyPlan AS sp INNER JOIN retail.DimScenario AS sc ON sp.ScenarioKey = sc.ScenarioKey WHERE toYear(sp.DateKey) = 2009 AND sc.ScenarioName = 'Budget' GROUP BY sp.ProductCategoryKey) AS bud ON pc.ProductCategoryKey = bud.ProductCategoryKey WHERE toYear(fs.DateKey) = 2009 GROUP BY pc.ProductCategoryName ORDER BY ActualSalesRevenue DESC
